lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like array of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming high-contrast anchor nodes that define a quadrilateral grid across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity concentrated on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several remoras (Echeneidae) positioned ventrally and trailing the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
